external_entities.name: reader
external_entities.description: A person who accesses the public site and fetches content from the web server or CDN.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Public site: readers hit the web server over HTTPS, some of them signed in.

external_entities.name: admin
external_entities.description: A person who maintains the database directly.
external_entities.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly rather than through the CMS.
external_entities.notes: The admin connects from wherever they happen to be; there is no jump host.

external_entities.name: CDN
external_entities.description: The content delivery network from which readers fetch images, stylesheets, and downloads.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP.

processes.name: web server
processes.description: The server hosting the public site and running the CMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database

processes.name: CMS
processes.description: The content management system running on the web server.
processes.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS

data_stores.name: MySQL database
data_stores.description: The database containing pages, accounts, and comments.
data_stores.source_excerpt: keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database on the same hosted network.
data_stores.notes: I could not tell you whether the database is encrypted on disk.

data_stores.name: bucket
data_stores.description: The CDN bucket receiving newly published assets.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket.

data_flows.name: serve site
data_flows.description: A reader accesses the public site on the web server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: readers hit the web server over HTTPS, some of them signed in.

data_flows.name: store content
data_flows.description: The web server keeps pages, accounts, and comments in the MySQL database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database

data_flows.name: fetch assets
data_flows.description: A reader fetches images, stylesheets, and downloads from the CDN.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP.

data_flows.name: publish assets
data_flows.description: The web server pushes newly published assets to the CDN bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When new assets are published the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket.
data_flows.notes: Nothing here tells you how the push to the CDN is authenticated.
data_flows.data_description: newly published images, stylesheets, and downloads

data_flows.name: maintain database
data_flows.description: The admin directly maintains the MySQL database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly rather than through the CMS.
data_flows.notes: The connection is unsecured, has no TLS, is straight to the box, and there is no jump host.

trust_boundaries.name: hosted network
trust_boundaries.description: The hosted network containing the web server, CMS, and MySQL database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database on the same hosted network.

assumptions.assumption: The web server is internet-facing because readers hit the public site on it.
assumptions.basis: The source calls it the public site and says readers hit the web server over HTTPS.

assumptions.assumption: The web server presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source describes it as the web server for the public site.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database is confidential because it contains accounts and comments, which may identify or describe people.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains accounts and comments.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN bucket contains public data because readers fetch its images, stylesheets, and downloads as part of the public site.
assumptions.basis: The source says the public site's readers fetch those assets from the CDN.
